ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: First describe the image: The figure is a spatial distribution map of the United States "preference index". The position marked "A" is in the inland north-central United States, close to the Great Plains area; judging from the legend and color distribution, the area where A is located belongs to an area with a relatively low "preference index". Then reason: The urban and cultural attractiveness of the Great Plains region of the north-central United States is relatively weak, and employment opportunities are not as abundant as in coastal areas and large urban belts. Local economic activities mainly rely on the broad plains to develop agriculture and animal husbandry. Therefore, the low preference index of Region A is also because the local area is mainly agriculture and animal husbandry.
